items.t: Cylinder head oil plug may leak and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel system leak and vapor recalls
items.job: Repair leaking fuel and vapor lines
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear bench seat bolts can break (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Built-in child seat problems (recalls)
items.job: Repair or replace built-in child seat harness
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Clock spring can disable the driver airbag (recalls)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel rail O-rings can leak (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Four-speed automatic slipping, no reverse or stuck in one gear
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Sometimes a solenoid pack or fluid service fixes it for much less. Use only the specified fluid.

items.t: Front lower control arm bolt can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front lower control arm bolt
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Water can drip into the radio and short it (recall)
items.job: Install water shield and replace damaged radio
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear A/C evaporator and lines corrode and leak
items.job: Replace corroded rear A/C lines and recharge
items.note: If the rear evaporator itself leaks, expect more.

items.t: Fuel tank control valve can leak (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power steering cooler hose can split (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor shaft can break (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front crash sensors can crack and fail (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control module can get wet and fail (recalls)
items.note: Covered by recalls. Fix any water leak into the footwell too.

items.t: Sliding door wiring can chafe and short (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run and shut the van off (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose in an airbag deployment (recall)
items.job: Secure or replace horn pad emblem
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Plastic coolant pipe leak
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.t: Brakes wear out early and rotors warp
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Price is for the front axle. Rear brakes cost about the same again.

items.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) failure
items.note: Diagnose first; a single relay or fuse sometimes fixes it. Module must be programmed to the van.

items.t: Vent window switch can overheat (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering column rivet may be missing (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag can deploy on its own (recall)
items.job: Replace clock spring or air bag wiring
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Left cylinder head failure and misfires
items.note: Chrysler's warranty extension for this has likely expired. Still ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Ticking from worn rocker arms
items.note: If the camshaft is worn too, cost rises a lot.

items.t: Oil filter housing leak
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly
items.note: Use the updated aluminum-style housing. Coolant may need to be refilled too.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing can fail from debris (recall)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 3.6L
items.note: Covered by recall for affected engines. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.

items.t: Right rear wheel hub may not be fully machined (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power liftgate may not reverse on an obstruction (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Airbag software errors (recalls)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Tire pressure warning may not alert (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Windshield may not stay in place in a crash (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Low end is rebonding the old glass; high end includes new glass.

items.t: Transmission pump can seize (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: The recall adds a software update, and failed units are usually replaced under it. Check your VIN.

items.t: Hood latch striker bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace and torque hood striker bolts
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seatback nuts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace third-row seatback nuts
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer can fail and stall the van (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake calipers may reduce braking (recall)
items.note: Price is for both rear calipers. Covered by recall; check your VIN first.

items.t: Second- and third-row seat latches may fail in a crash (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.
